# Neyvro Agent Skills

Portable, on-demand skills for Neyvro-compatible AI agents.

## Skills
- [account-research](account-research/SKILL.md): Activate when researching a specific company or authorized buyer for a GTM decision, outreach draft, qualification review, or investigation; use existing Neyvro company-twin evidence before requesting new research.
- [buyer-matching](buyer-matching/SKILL.md): Activate when matching a target account or problem to buyer roles using authorized company and contact evidence.
- [buyer-opportunity-matching](buyer-opportunity-matching/SKILL.md): Activate when matching an evidence-backed company problem or opportunity to people likely responsible for solving, influencing, approving, or blocking it.
- [buying-window-detection](buying-window-detection/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing whether verified company, leadership, technology, funding, security, hiring, or product signals justify attention now under the customer’s ICP and authorization rules.
- [buying-windows](buying-windows/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing whether dated company changes create a timely, evidence-backed opportunity to investigate or propose outreach.
- [cold-email-writing](cold-email-writing/SKILL.md): Activate when drafting or reviewing an evidence-grounded outbound email from an authorized opportunity, buyer, product, positioning, channel, and tone; this skill never sends messages.
- [company-changes](company-changes/SKILL.md): Activate when detecting, explaining, or reviewing material changes in a target company's business context.
- [company-digital-twin-analysis](company-digital-twin-analysis/SKILL.md): Activate when reconstructing an authorized company’s current state, historical timeline, transitions, and supporting evidence from Neyvro digital-twin data; never fill unknown fields from assumptions.
- [content-marketing-engine](content-marketing-engine/SKILL.md): Activate when planning, drafting, repurposing, distributing, or measuring customer content from verified buyer questions, positioning, research, and approved brand voice; publishing always requires an authorized channel and explicit approval.
- [continuous-account-investigation](continuous-account-investigation/SKILL.md): Activate when reviewing unresolved company questions, selecting permitted next research actions, and enforcing freshness, scope, cost, and research-budget limits for ongoing account investigation.
- [continuous-investigation](continuous-investigation/SKILL.md): Activate when creating, monitoring, reviewing, assigning, or correcting a bounded Neyvro investigation.
- [digital-twins](digital-twins/SKILL.md): Activate when building or reviewing an evidence-backed, time-aware projection of a company, buyer, or opportunity.
- [discovery-and-qualification](discovery-and-qualification/SKILL.md): Activate when qualifying an authorized sales opportunity or preparing a discovery-call brief using evidence, buyer research, conversation context, CRM records, and meeting history; never qualify from AI inference alone.
- [email-deliverability](email-deliverability/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing authorized Gmail or Microsoft mailbox readiness, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, sender limits, bounce or complaint risk, recipient hygiene, or safe email ramp-up; never change DNS or send mail.
- [evidence](evidence/SKILL.md): Activate when collecting, viewing, evaluating, correcting, or citing source-attributed evidence for Neyvro intelligence.
- [evidence-verification](evidence-verification/SKILL.md): Activate when checking whether a company, buyer, technology, opportunity, or revenue claim is observed, inferred, stale, contradictory, or unsupported by authorized Neyvro evidence.
- [generative-engine-optimization](generative-engine-optimization/SKILL.md): Activate when assessing or improving an authorized website’s discoverability, answer-first content, entity clarity, structured data, AI-crawler access, freshness, or measurement plan for AI answer engines; never promise citations or fabricate visibility.
- [gtm-automation-with-chronos](gtm-automation-with-chronos/SKILL.md): Activate when a user asks to turn GTM planning into external execution through an authorized MCP or provider.
- [gtm-automation-with-neyvro](gtm-automation-with-neyvro/SKILL.md): Activate when coordinating Neyvro knowledge skills with connected customer intelligence, research, drafting, campaign, mailbox, conversation, meeting, SEO/GEO, content, or analytics services; use capability discovery and approval gates before any external action.
- [gtm-strategy](gtm-strategy/SKILL.md): Activate when selecting, reviewing, or refining a product's go-to-market motion, acquisition channels, or 30/60/90-day execution plan.
- [ideal-customer-profile](ideal-customer-profile/SKILL.md): Activate when defining, refining, scoring, or reviewing an ICP, buyer personas, target-account filters, trigger events, or anti-ICP rules.
- [lead-sourcing-and-enrichment](lead-sourcing-and-enrichment/SKILL.md): Activate when selecting ICP-fit accounts, finding buyer roles, or enriching authorized business contacts with deduplicated, provenance-labeled, verified data.
- [linkedin-outreach](linkedin-outreach/SKILL.md): Activate when researching an authorized professional profile, selecting a relevant LinkedIn outreach angle, drafting a connection note or direct message, or recording customer-confirmed manual outreach; never automate LinkedIn actions.
- [multichannel-sequences](multichannel-sequences/SKILL.md): Activate when designing, reviewing, compiling, or operating a customer-approved multichannel outreach sequence with deterministic timing, branches, eligibility checks, and stop rules.
- [negative-evidence](negative-evidence/SKILL.md): Activate when recording, evaluating, or explaining disconfirming evidence, missing signals, or reasons not to act.
- [negative-evidence-analysis](negative-evidence-analysis/SKILL.md): Activate when actively looking for verified facts, missing prerequisites, contradictions, or disqualifiers that weaken an account, buyer, opportunity, or predictive hypothesis.
- [outbound-metrics-and-benchmarks](outbound-metrics-and-benchmarks/SKILL.md): Activate when analyzing outbound funnel performance, campaign health, attribution, or contextual benchmarks using Neyvro campaign, conversation, and CRM records; every metric must expose its numerator, denominator, time window, segment, and data limitations.
- [outreach-personalization](outreach-personalization/SKILL.md): Activate when turning authorized company, buyer, opportunity, positioning, and brand-voice context into evidence-linked personalization snippets at strategic, qualified, or lightweight effort levels; never send messages.
- [positioning-and-messaging](positioning-and-messaging/SKILL.md): Activate when developing, reviewing, or refining product positioning, value propositions, battlecards, buyer messaging, or approved message-house claims.
- [predictive-problem-intelligence](predictive-problem-intelligence/SKILL.md): Activate when mapping verified company or technology changes to possible customer-relevant problems, while keeping hypotheses distinct from facts and respecting the customer ICP.
- [predictive-problems](predictive-problems/SKILL.md): Activate when identifying or reviewing likely future business problems from current evidence and patterns.
- [reply-handling-and-objections](reply-handling-and-objections/SKILL.md): Activate when retrieving and classifying an authorized email reply, drafting an objection-aware response, or stopping follow-up after a reply, rejection, unsubscribe, meeting, or out-of-office event.
- [revenue-attribution](revenue-attribution/SKILL.md): Activate when tracing authorized signals through buyers, campaigns, meetings, opportunities, deals, and revenue using an explicit attribution model and complete provenance.
- [seo-fundamentals](seo-fundamentals/SKILL.md): Activate when auditing an explicitly authorized website for technical SEO, crawlability, indexing, metadata, headings, internal links, content relevance, page experience, mobile readiness, or structured data; this optional module never deploys or merges changes.
- [technology-change-detection](technology-change-detection/SKILL.md): Activate when identifying authorized, evidence-backed technology adoption, migration, engineering, or infrastructure changes and gaps between current and desired state.

## Loading

Use metadata discovery first, then load one exact `SKILL.md`; do not inject the whole bundle into every request.
